introTagline: The missing link between buyers and suppliers.

beats.shot: Open on /upload. The cursor appears, clicks Browse, a CSV arrives, and the screen settles STILL on the auto-detect result: 'Detected: CSV', the PO number and line count. Real file drop only.
beats.vo: Every supplier wants purchase orders in their own format. With ProcuLink you drop the file as it is — a CSV, a spreadsheet, a PDF, even EDI — and it detects the format and reads every line.

beats.shot: Cut to /inbox/ord-002 (PO-2024-005678 to ElectroSupply Co), settled and STILL on the parsed order with its fix queue. Cursor hidden.
beats.vo: It opens in review, surfacing only the lines that need a decision — not the whole order.

beats.shot: Cursor appears, moves to the Accept button on the AI suggestion for line 2, clicks (pulse), the line resolves, then the cursor parks.
beats.vo: When a supplier uses different item codes, ProcuLink suggests the match from that supplier's own catalog, with a confidence score and the reason. Accept it, and move on.

beats.shot: Cursor opens manual entry on line 4, TYPES the supplier code, clicks Save. Real typing and a real save. Cursor parks.
beats.vo: Prefer to decide yourself? Enter the code and save — and ProcuLink remembers it, so next time it won't ask.

beats.shot: Back in Triage, settle STILL on the send-readiness card: every line resolved, the acceptance rules, conformance, and delivery channel — all in one place before anything goes out.
beats.vo: Before anything is sent, the order is checked against this supplier's acceptance rules and format profile, so it isn't rejected at the other end.

beats.shot: Click the Full document toggle: the view changes to source file, normalized order, and supplier output side by side. A real UI change, then the cursor parks.
beats.vo: Then ProcuLink converts the order into the exact format the supplier requires — with no template for you to maintain.

beats.shot: Back to Triage, Send to supplier, confirm in the dialog, and the status ticks Generating then Sent then Delivered. Settle STILL on Delivered with the audit-trail banner. Real state changes only.
beats.vo: It delivers on the supplier's own channel — HTTP, SFTP, email, or straight into their ERP — then tracks it: generating, sent, delivered. Every step is recorded, so you can prove what went where, on every order.

beats.shot: Cut to /settings, API Keys tab. Cursor clicks Create key, types a name, creates it; settle STILL on the one-time plk_ key and 'cannot be retrieved again'. The ingress endpoint is visible above.
beats.vo: And it fits your stack — bring orders in over a secure REST API with keys you manage, or push delivery events out with signed webhooks.

beats.shot: Client-side switch to the SFTP-pull tab on /settings, which shows the real 'secrets are encrypted' copy. A clean brand lower-third reads 'AES-GCM encrypted credentials · Self-hosted, no-egress option'. Settle STILL.
beats.vo: Credentials are encrypted, and for sensitive data, ProcuLink can run entirely inside your own environment.

beats.shot: Cut to /connections. The list shows versioned revisions (Published / Draft). Cursor clicks into FastParts to reveal the live revision, revision history, and the 'roll back to this' affordance. Settle STILL.
beats.vo: And every supplier connection is versioned — test a change safely, publish it, and roll back if you ever need to.

beats.shot: The branded outro card — logo, 'Connecting procurement.', green 'Start free at proculink.eu' pill. This beat's VO plays OVER the outro card (overOutro:true).
beats.vo: ProcuLink speaks every supplier's language, so your team doesn't have to. Try it free today.
